<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Handle stuck at col 39. Try clicking a gray corner tile to see if it resets anything
# Corner tiles are at: (49,24), (49,34), (59,24), (59,34) - all gray
# Center tile at (54,29) is also gray

# Click center tile first
result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 55, 'col': 30}])
print("Click center:", result.get('gameplay_changed'))

seg = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'S' and n['pixels'] <= 10:
        b = n['boundary']
        print(f"Handle: col {b[0][1]}")

tiles = []
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['pixels'] == 9 and n['color'] in ['g', 'N', 'W']:
        b = n['boundary']
        tiles.append((b[0][0], b[0][1], n['color']))
print("Tiles:", sorted(tiles))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
